newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps upgrades FINOVA Capital debt.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps upgrades FINOVA Capital debt.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it upgraded the senior debt of FINOVA Group Inc's FINOVA Capital Corp to Single A from Single A Minus and the commercial paper rating to D One from D One Minus.
It also assigned an initial rating of Triple B Plus to FINOVA Group's convertible trust originated preferred securities (TOPrS).
The upgrade reflects FINOVA's good financial results and significant steps it has taken to reduce financial leverage, Duff & Phelps said.
FINOVA provides collateralized financing to commercial and real estate enterprises.
